# Xplania — full description

> Xplania (https://xplania.app) is a web app, in French and English, for students going abroad for an Erasmus, a university exchange or an internship. During the beta it focuses on one need: preparing the departure. Founded by Juliette Noël. Advice is always tied to the student's destination, never generic.

Xplania does not sell flights, hotels or tours, does not publish housing listings and takes no booking or payment for the stay.

## How it works

1. Answer a 2-minute questionnaire (7 questions: destination, origin, type of stay, dates, budget, housing situation). No account is needed.
2. See the 3 priorities for this stay right away.
3. Create a free account to save the trip; the answers are kept, even when the email is confirmed on another device.
4. Prepare with the five connected tools. The dashboard shows the next step and a prioritised list of what is left. Optional email reminders are sent before departure (60, 10, 7 and 5 days before).

## The five preparation tools

- Budget (/guide-budget): first-month budget (deposit, rent, setup costs), monthly costs and income (grant, internship allowance, family help), the real margin, saving tips, PDF export. Amounts are never changed without the student's confirmation. Usable without an account.
- Visa & paperwork (/guide-visa): formalities for the student's nationality and stay, summarized from official sources (France Diplomatie, Institut Pasteur, official entry sites of the country) with the consultation date, and a checklist that always keeps the essential steps. Fees and deadlines are shown only when they appear in the official text. For non-French nationals the answer is marked "to confirm" next to the official site. Usable without an account.
- Packing list (/guide-valise): checklist based on the usual weather of the months on site, the type of stay (Erasmus, internship, cabin or hold luggage, sport) and the student's activities. Account required (choices are saved per trip).
- Culture guide (/guide-culture): cultural codes of the destination — greetings, social life, studies and work — as "do / avoid / good to know" cards with examples, a daily gesture and a mini-quiz. Hand-written sheets for 29 countries; other countries are generated by AI on request. These are tendencies, not rules. Usable without an account.
- Housing assistant (/guide-logement): where to search (hand-checked official, student and association websites, no partnership), a comparator for places found elsewhere, warning signs of scams, lease and move-in steps, maximum rent linked to the Budget. An optional AI assistant answers questions and never invents websites. Account required.

Each tool has its own assistant (Ping) for questions about that tool.

## Country guides

Public guides (/preparer) for 29 destinations: Spain, United Kingdom, Netherlands, Poland, United States, Australia, Japan, China, Mexico, Brazil, Indonesia, South Korea, New Zealand, Portugal, Chile, Argentina, Denmark, Sweden, Italy, Hungary, Switzerland, Norway, Greece, South Africa, Austria, Bulgaria, Ireland, Peru and India. Each guide gives visa and entry links, health recommendations, budget items, housing resources and cultural codes. Islands and overseas territories with different rules are covered (French overseas departments and Pacific territories, Canary and Balearic Islands, Madeira and the Azores, Sicily and Sardinia, Greek islands, Faroe Islands and Greenland, Svalbard, Easter Island, Bali). Every external link is tested automatically each day.

## Access

- Beta: free, no card required, up to 10 AI tries per AI tool per month (a failed generation is given back).
- Student packs and school pricing are shown on /offres; payments are not active yet. A school pays the student price multiplied by its number of students.

## Privacy

No resale of data; the account and data can be deleted anytime. Details on /securite and /politique-de-confidentialite.
